summary: MediWound Ltd. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a firm-commitment underwritten offering of 1,200,000 ordinary shares at $12.50 per share, grossing $15.0 million, versus a $13.50 last-sale price on November 2, 2026 (roughly a 7.4% discount). H.C. Wainwright is sole underwriter, with a 30-day option for 180,000 additional shares; blended discount is $0.41 per share, netting $14.5 million before expenses. Delivery expected November 5, 2026. This is a routine primary equity shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution and follow-on pricing pressure.
